options.name: Three-Act Structure
options.description: Slow build-up in Act 1, increasing tension in Act 2, and rapid climax in Act 3
options.examples: Character introduction scenes, rising action sequences, climactic finale

options.name: Varying Scene Lengths
options.description: Quick cuts for energy, longer takes for depth, mixing it up to prevent monotony
options.examples: Action montages, emotional dialogue scenes, establishing shots

options.name: Measured Pacing
options.description: Slower, more consistent rhythm to allow for information absorption
options.examples: Expert interviews, detailed explanations, archival footage

options.name: Alternating Tempos
options.description: Slower rhythms for reflection, quicker tempos for high-energy segments
options.examples: Contemplative nature scenes, dramatic reenactments, news footage

options.name: Fast-Paced Rhythm
options.description: Quick cuts, dynamic camera movements, and rapid scene transitions to heighten tension
options.examples: Chase sequences, fight scenes, rapid montages

options.name: Contrast Pacing
options.description: Alternating between fast and slow pacing to create unpredictability and keep viewers engaged
options.examples: Quiet character moments, sudden action bursts, suspense building

options.name: Balanced Pacing
options.description: Alternating between fast-paced, high-energy segments and slower, more informative sections
options.examples: Quick overview segments, detailed demonstrations, practice sessions

options.name: Deliberate Pacing
options.description: Slower pace for complex concepts, allowing viewers to absorb information
options.examples: Step-by-step tutorials, concept explanations, review sections

options.name: Energetic Pacing
options.description: Faster and more dynamic to generate enthusiasm and encourage action
options.examples: Product highlights, testimonial montages, call-to-action sequences

options.name: Music-Driven Rhythm
options.description: Using upbeat music combined with quick-paced editing to create momentum
options.examples: Brand montages, lifestyle sequences, product demonstrations
